The '''''Wyvard''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] that served under [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Porrak Vansyn]] at the [[Battle over Exodo II]].<ref name="ascension" />
